This candidate adds stable common author profile anchors for Feed, Official and public profile comments, and opens the shared public profile from comment authors in Web/Wasm, Android and iOS.

Feed and Official comment author profile entry closes the comment sheet before opening the shared profile to avoid Web/Wasm profile content being hidden behind the sheet; Android runner preserves strict return checks for other profile-entry flows and relaxes this case only.

Public profile comments now expose the common translator trigger and reuse the existing FastText-based language identification path on Web/Wasm and iOS; Android keeps its native translator controller while sharing common comments UI.

Web/Wasm records a controlled bridge fallback when the Compose bottom-sheet dismiss layer intercepts a resolved semantic author anchor. The fallback is diagnostic, occurs after resolving the stable anchor, and is followed by profile visibility checks, database verification and cleanup residue checks.
This does not declare full OVR-COMMENTS, FLOW-TRANSLATOR or FLOW-EMOJI GO: replies, pagination, forced error/rollback paths, mixed emoji-plus-link rendering and full visual comparison remain pending.
